citations.claim: At step 123 EW approaches were yellow while NS were red, one second before the violation
At step 124 NS turned green after only 0s all-red while emergency for S active, violating all_red_clearance

counterfactual.change: Removed the single emergency event (events -> []); without preemption the cycle runs full yellow and all-red so no clearance violation occurs.

explanation: Emergency preemption forces its direction green immediately: at step 122 EW was green, at 123 EW yellow with emergency active, at 124 NS green. The controller cut yellow short (1s vs 6s required) and skipped the 2s all-red, so NS turned green after 0s of all-red, violating all_red_clearance (and yellow_duration).

violation.detail: approach 0 turned green after only 0 s of all-red (need 2 s)

vision_note: Through step 122 one axis shows green while the cross axis shows red, then in step 123 those greens turn to yellow. In step 124 green appears immediately on the perpendicular axis, with no intervening step where all approaches are red.
